title: Keybindings
description:
AGENTS: before modifying this schema, read AGENTS.md at the repository root.

Maps logical action names to physical input bindings. See ADR-0011.

actions.description: Map from logical action name to one or more input bindings. Each key is a snake_case action name matching the LogicalAction enum in delta-v-core.

action_bindings.description: Input bindings for a single logical action.

keyboard.description: List of Bevy KeyCode variant names (e.g. "KeyW", "ArrowUp") that trigger this action. Empty list means no keyboard binding.

gamepad_button.description: Optional gamepad button name. Null means no gamepad binding.
